preconditions.description: X and Y must be strings.
The lengths of X and Y must be between 1 and 10^3 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(c in Y for c in X if c.isupper()) and all(c.isupper() or c not in X for c in Y) else return_value == 0
postconditions.description: The return value is 1 if Y can be obtained by converting some lowercase letters in X to uppercase and deleting all lowercase letters in X, otherwise 0.
